item.title: Capturing Confidence on Camera With Tigz Rice
item.description: Eelcomes empowerment photographer and body positivity advocate Tigz Rice. Known for her viral boudoir pose tutorials and a career built on capturing the many layers of identity, Tigz joins the conversation with sass, softness, and unapologetic sparkle. Whether she’s working behind the lens or showing up for talks, Tigz encourages people—especially plus-size women—to step into their bodies with joy, vulnerability, and fierce self-love.

item.description: Burlesque superstars Miss Terriboxx & Mama Mamba join BxSassy on The Sassy Show to discuss their journeys, from MMA cages to glitter stages. Hear how drag and cabaret shaped their confidence, why diversity matters, and their advice for aspiring performers.

item.title: Beyond OnlyFans: Alice Lovegood’s Journey into Kink Education
item.description: Bethany sits down with kink educator and content creator Alice Lovegood (Better Sx Blog) for a candid, funny, and deeply honest conversation about polyamory, pleasure, kink, going viral online, and creating real-life spaces for people to connect. Alice shares her journey from OnlyFans to education, the challenges of visibility, and how she’s reshaping conversations around sex - one video, one workshop, and one event at a time.

item.title: Ajamu X: Punk, Pleasure, and the Politics of Black Queer Softness
item.description: Photographic artist Ajamu X in conversation about Black Queer bodies, pleasure, and the radical act of gentleness. From his post-punk roots in Northern England to his darkroom practice, Ajamu shares why he creates softer representations of black masculinity, his inspiration from Rotimi Fani-Kayode, and his philosophy on sensuality. Expect honest talk about foot fetishes, navigating the art world, and his cheeky advice to younger artists: be kinkier, be sexier, push it further.
